name: heartland-network
description: Heartland Network — a self-hosted broadband network building and management strategy game.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @heartland/shared && npm run build -w @heartland/server && npm run build -w @heartland/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @heartland/shared && npm run typecheck -w @heartland/shared && npm run typecheck -w @heartland/server && npm run typecheck -w @heartland/client
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
